title: All Day Unlimited Games in Monterey
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
high chairs are available in the restaurant
All Day Unlimited Games - free to come and go during the day
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unleash your adventurous side with our Unlimited Games Package! This pass grants you the freedom to explore Monterey's delights while indulging in some truly unique fun. Dive into the only underground mini golf course in Monterey, where vibrant neon lights and exciting, age-friendly obstacles create an unforgettable experience.

But that's not all – you'll also get to try our exclusive 1-2 Putt game, found only at Tipsy Putt. This one-of-a-kind 9-hole course combines the best elements of golf, shuffleboard, and pool, encouraging you to enjoy a drink while you play. With no time limits, you can play as many rounds as you like, making every visit a new adventure.

Take breaks whenever you want to refuel with delicious food and sip on local beer, wine, and cocktails. The Unlimited Games Package ensures an exciting and memorable day filled with fun, laughter, and endless possibilities!
